metric_population.population_label: OUT-positive subset of the hash-bound Selection-125 scope
metric_population.inclusion_rule: A query is included only when the frozen relation source contains at least one positive relation with domain_rel equal to OUT.
metric_population.exclusion_rule: A scoped query with no positive OUT relation is excluded only from OUT metric vectors and paired statistics. It is not excluded from Selection membership, ranking-package coverage, qrels coverage, access control, or profile execution.
metric_population.non_inference: The audit does not label the 35 non-OUT-eligible queries as IN-only because this aggregate-safe record does not inspect or export their protected relation composition.

evaluator_semantics.ranking_input_scope: All four frozen profiles submit Top-100 rankings for all 125 opaque Selection work tokens.
evaluator_semantics.qrels_scope: The Owner-local evaluator materializes non-empty qrels for all 125 scoped tokens before computing metrics.
evaluator_semantics.metric_vector_scope: The evaluator iterates only the eligible_out token set. Therefore every OUT metric vector has exactly 90 values and must not be padded with 35 zeroes or missing values.
evaluator_semantics.statistical_scope: Paired bootstrap confidence intervals and W/T/L for A4 Selection are defined on the same 90 OUT-eligible paired units.
evaluator_semantics.publication_wording: Report 'Selection-125 exposure and coverage; OUT metric denominator n=90'. Do not report the 90 values as estimates over all 125 Selection queries.

claim_boundary: This resolves the Selection scope and OUT metric denominator. It does not reopen Selection, alter the A4 decision, alter the A5 Final result, or establish an all-Selection OUT metric.
